title: CAD Editor system design
summary: A leased polling worker that generates the first model for a linked blank part or safely edits an indexed part, then validates, commits, reindexes, and schedules export.

nodes.label: Edit Jobs
nodes.description: Postgres edit_jobs rows owning workflow mode, explicit linked-part scope, hashes, child-job IDs, history, leases, and terminal results.

details.responsibility: Durably own each resumable CAD edit workflow and its reclaimable worker lease.

inputs.name: edit request
inputs.description: Project-scoped request_text and recent user/assistant messages.

outputs.name: claimed workflow
outputs.description: The oldest queued or lease-expired running row after ownership is assigned.

outputs.name: terminal result
outputs.description: Completed or failed result with targets, attempts, child IDs, warnings, and recovery outcome.

durableWrites: workflow_mode, requested_part_id, state, status, worker_id, heartbeat_at, and lease_expires_at
validation, index, and export child-job IDs
history, result, error_code, and bounded error_message

nodes.label: 1. Lease Claim
nodes.description: Claims one queued or expired edit job and maintains its lease while dependencies run.

details.responsibility: Acquire one workflow for this worker ID and hand it to the resumable orchestrator.
trigger: The process polls continuously; an empty claim sleeps for CAD_EDITOR_JOB_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS.

outputs.name: claimed edit job
outputs.description: A row already changed to running with a worker ID and lease expiry.

failureConditions.outcome: The process sleeps and polls again.
The exception is outside the per-job try block and terminates the worker process.

operations.concurrency: One job at a time per worker process; deployment configuration runs one editor replica.
operations.retry: Empty polls repeat. Claim exceptions are not caught by the polling loop.

nodes.label: 2. Fresh Index Gate
nodes.description: For every edit mode, requires a fresh project index before planning. The exact blank marker is excluded, so initial design can proceed with an empty or mixed-project index.

details.responsibility: Require a fresh project Getter before target resolution or initial-model generation.
steps: Try to create a Getter for the project.
Return it immediately when freshness status is fresh.
Otherwise queue or reuse a build_index row and poll it to a terminal state.
Recreate the Getter and require fresh status after a completed build.
Treat the exact blank CAD marker as intentionally absent from source signatures.
details.shortCircuit: A failed index job or a still-stale Getter raises INDEX_BUILD_FAILED or STALE_INDEX before planning.

operations.timeout: Child-job polling uses CAD_EDITOR_DEPENDENCY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, 300 seconds by default.
operations.retry: The editor does not retry a failed child job; the queue RPC can reuse an active build.

nodes.label: Index Jobs
nodes.description: Postgres index_jobs rows used for pre-edit freshness and mandatory post-commit reindexing.

details.responsibility: Durably hand build_index work to the independent Indexer Worker and expose terminal status.
downstream: The independent Indexer Worker claims these rows; the CAD Editor only queues and polls them.

nodes.label: 3. Resolve + Context
nodes.description: Uses a linked requested_part_id as the authoritative established-part target, or resolves one part project-wide when no part is linked.

details.responsibility: Enforce one part, snapshot accepted source, and expose its server-owned replacement and extension targets.
preconditions: The project Getter must remain fresh.

inputs.name: request and messages
inputs.description: The edit request, optional requested_part_id, and at most eight normalized recent messages.

inputs.name: Getter metadata
inputs.description: Ranked features, source chunks, parameters, dependencies, and content hashes.

outputs.name: resolved target
outputs.description: The linked part with all existing features, or one project-resolved part with selected semantic IDs.

outputs.name: allowed targets
outputs.description: AST-derived parameter, decorator, feature-body, and build_model-body regions.

decisionPoints: A requested_part_id always wins and cannot be redirected to a different part.
For unlinked requests, a high-confidence match at least 0.80 and 0.10 above the runner-up resolves automatically.
No matches may use one structured search-query expansion.
Ambiguous ranked matches use structured target selection restricted to candidate IDs.
details.shortCircuit: A missing requested part, invented IDs, cross-part selection, stale Getter data, or a source-hash race fails the workflow.

nodes.label: 4. Structured Planning
nodes.description: Requests a strict EditPlan for an established part or a complete initial AI-owned model body for a linked blank part.

details.responsibility: Turn bounded edit context into Pydantic operations, or a blank-part request into a complete Pydantic-validated initial model body.
details.runsIn: CadEditAgent using the OpenAI Responses API

inputs.name: InitialCadDesignContext
inputs.description: Request, bounded conversation, and the linked blank part identity; no Getter data exists yet.

inputs.name: EditContext or RepairContext
inputs.description: Focused established-source metadata, targets, latest candidate chunks, and diagnostics.

outputs.name: InitialCadModel or EditPlan
outputs.description: A complete initial model body, or one to twelve scoped replacement/addition operations for an established part.

guarantees: Strict Pydantic models reject extra fields and unsupported operation shapes.

operations.retry: OpenAI calls have no editor-level retry. Persisted candidates and plans prevent regeneration after later side effects.

nodes.label: OpenAI Responses API
nodes.description: External structured-output dependency used for query extraction, ambiguous target selection, initial planning, and repair planning.

details.responsibility: Return parsed strict models for bounded decisions; it does not receive storage or database credentials.

inputs.name: structured request payload
inputs.description: A JSON payload selected for the specific query, selection, plan, or repair operation.

failureConditions.outcome: AI_REFUSAL or AI_RESPONSE_INVALID fails the edit workflow.

nodes.label: 5. Deterministic Apply
nodes.description: Composes an initial model behind the system-owned import, or applies validated replacements and safe additions within one established part.

details.responsibility: Produce candidate model.py bytes through system-owned initial composition or a deterministic established-part EditPlan.
preconditions: The base source SHA-256 must equal the plan context hash.
steps: For initial design, preserve the system-owned runtime import and write the complete AI-owned body as a candidate.
For established edits, resolve allowed AST-derived spans and reject unknown, duplicate, overlapping, cross-part, or incompatible targets.
Validate additive ModelParams fields, private helpers, server-decorated CAD features, and build_model-body changes.
Reject model-supplied imports/decorators, duplicate names or semantic IDs, and unknown feature parameters/dependencies.
Apply established replacements and insertions from the end of the file toward the start, then parse the complete candidate.
details.successCondition: The candidate records its base hash, content hash, changed symbols, and persisted initial model or scoped operations; independent validation decides acceptance.

nodes.label: Edit Candidate Storage
nodes.description: Job-scoped object-storage prefix holding the original accepted backup and each hash-verified candidate attempt.

details.responsibility: Durably separate unaccepted candidate source and rollback material from canonical source.
guarantees: Every write is downloaded and SHA-256 verified before the workflow advances.

failureConditions.outcome: The workflow result keeps a warning; the terminal status is not hidden.

nodes.label: Validation Jobs
nodes.description: Postgres generation_jobs rows binding validate_cad work to an exact candidate path, hash, attempt, and edit job.

details.responsibility: Durably hand candidate validation to the independent CAD Validator and expose its structured result.
durableWrites: validate_cad row with source_kind=candidate, source_storage_path, source_sha256, edit_job_id, and status
downstream: The independent CAD Validator claims the row. The CAD Editor polls it and never calls the validator service directly.

nodes.label: 6. Proof + Commit
nodes.description: Classifies validation results, plans bounded repairs when allowed, or commits only an exact passed proof.

details.responsibility: Control the repair loop and make canonical replacement conditional on exact validation and source proofs.
preconditions: Validation job is completed validate_cad candidate work owned by this edit.
Candidate path and SHA-256 match the persisted current candidate.
Result status is passed and valid is true.
decisionPoints: Repairable, candidate-scoped diagnostics may create the next attempt.
Non-repairable results, dependency failures, source races, and attempt three stop.
Canonical source must still equal the accepted hash or already equal this candidate hash.
details.shortCircuit: A failed proof cannot write canonical source. A failed post-commit reindex triggers guarded rollback.
details.successCondition: Candidate source is written and hash-verified, then a completed reindex produces a fresh Getter. Established edits must also contain every resolved semantic target; initial design has no pre-existing targets.

operations.concurrency: A database constraint prevents two active resolved edits from owning the same project part.
operations.retry: At most three validation attempts: one initial candidate and up to two repair candidates.
observability: Terminal result records the state, attempt count, targets, recovery result, details, and warnings.

nodes.label: Canonical CAD Source
nodes.description: Accepted project CAD source that is replaced only after exact candidate validation and unchanged-source checks.

details.responsibility: Durably own accepted CAD model source and parameters.
durableReads: Accepted model.py used for source and race hashes.
durableWrites: Validated candidate model.py; original model.py during guarded rollback.

nodes.label: Export Jobs
nodes.description: Postgres generation_jobs rows for best-effort hash-bound export_cad handoff after successful reindexing.

details.responsibility: Durably hand artifact generation to the independent CAD Exporter.
durableWrites: queued export_cad row with the committed candidate hash and edit_job_id
downstream: The CAD Exporter independently claims this row; the CAD Editor does not call the exporter directly.

failureConditions.outcome: The valid indexed edit still completes with a warning and no export_job_id.

details.summary: The worker initiates every lease operation; edit_jobs never calls the worker.
details.durability: The claim atomically records running status, worker ownership, heartbeat, and lease expiry.
details.failureBehavior: Losing a heartbeat raises EDIT_LEASE_LOST. An initial claim exception terminates the polling process.

response.label: child ID and terminal index row

details.summary: The editor requests durable work and polls its row before both initial design and established editing; it does not call the Indexer Worker.
details.durability: The RPC creates or reuses an active build and saves index_job_id on edit_jobs in the same transaction.
details.failureBehavior: Failure, timeout, or a still-stale Getter stops pre-edit planning.

edges.label: linked blank part after fresh-index barrier

response.label: search phrases or selected target IDs

details.summary: This call occurs only for missing direct matches or ambiguous ranked matches; high-confidence resolution skips it.
details.trustBoundary: Only the request and bounded candidate metadata cross to the external API.

request.label: blank-part request or focused edit context

response.label: validated InitialCadModel or EditPlan

details.summary: For an established part the model returns bounded replacement or additive operations only. For a linked blank part it returns the complete AI-owned body; the server retains the runtime import and all storage writes.
details.trustBoundary: Focused source chunks and diagnostics cross to the external API; Supabase credentials and write authority do not.
details.failureBehavior: Refusal, missing parsed output, or request failure stops the workflow.

details.summary: The orchestrator initiates both upload and verification download for initial-design and established-edit candidates.
details.durability: Candidate source is separate from canonical source and its event is persisted before validation is queued.
details.failureBehavior: A storage or hash-verification failure prevents validation handoff.

details.summary: The RPC atomically creates or reuses validate_cad work and records the current candidate and validation_job_id on edit_jobs.
details.durability: A generation_jobs row binds the exact candidate path, hash, attempt, and owning edit.

details.summary: The editor polls the database row and heartbeats its edit lease while waiting.
details.failureBehavior: Timeout, failed infrastructure work, invalid proof, non-repairable diagnostics, or attempt exhaustion fails the edit.

request.label: upsert validated candidate or guarded rollback

details.summary: Proof + Commit initiates every canonical read and write; storage never initiates work.
preconditions: Exact validation proof matches this edit, candidate path, and candidate hash.
Canonical hash still matches accepted source or already equals this candidate.
details.durability: Canonical model.py changes before mandatory post-commit reindexing.
details.failureBehavior: Reindex failure restores the original only when canonical still equals the candidate; independent changes cause a recovery conflict instead of overwrite.

details.summary: Completion requires both a completed child job and a fresh Getter. Established edits must retain their resolved semantic targets; initial design has none before its first index.
details.failureBehavior: Failure or stale/missing target retrieval triggers guarded canonical rollback and fails the edit.

details.summary: The editor queues durable work; it does not invoke the CAD Exporter service.
details.durability: The RPC saves export_job_id on edit_jobs with the new generation_jobs row.
details.failureBehavior: Queuing failure becomes a warning; the valid reindexed edit still completes.

details.summary: The orchestrator writes completed or failed state after its success or recovery path resolves.
details.durability: Completion clears lease expiry and records result; failure records code, bounded message, details, and recovery outcome.

boundaries.label: CAD Editor Worker
boundaries.description: One leased polling process owns initial source composition, established deterministic mutation, dependency polling, commit, rollback, and cleanup.

boundaries.label: Server-owned mutation boundary
boundaries.description: For established parts the external model selects strict operations. For blank parts it returns an AI-owned body; only server code owns the runtime import, candidate bytes, validation handoff, and canonical writes.
